name: Native Lazy Load Animation
description: Adds a CSS/JS-driven fade/reveal animation to images and iframes that use the native HTML5 loading="lazy" attribute, triggering when they finish loading.
project_description:
Native Lazy Load Animation adds a simple fade in effect to lazy loaded images.

 As of Drupal 9.1 lazy loading on images has been available, this module is very simple and adds classes to these images so that a fade in effect can be applied.

 Usage 
 There is currently no config for this module, simply enable it and if any images are found with the loading attribute set to "lazy" extra classes will be applied so that the fade in effect works.
